name: Medicinal Chemistry
description: Basic principles of chemical biology. Structure, conformation and reactivity; chemical mechanisms of enzyme catalysis; Macromolecule synthesis, Combinatorial chemistry, bioorthogonal reactions; chemical genetics and small-molecule inhibitor screening; Pharmacokinetics, enzyme inhibition, drug design, Chemical methods to synthesize proteins and peptides, Ligand design for a medicinally relevant target, Protein-protein interactions, Ligands for protein surfaces, Small molecule arrays.
